title: Nonnegativity of random-string probability
statement: For any nonnegative integer $m$ and any decidable property $A$ of Boolean strings, the probability that a uniformly random Boolean string of length $m$ satisfies $A$ is nonnegative.
hypotheses_covered: $A$ is a decidable property of Boolean strings
